title: Rust SCHC authenticated-DIO capability issuance omits local destination binding
description: Security review P2. PeerContextAuthority::issue_from_authenticated_dio and AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext::from_authenticated_dio_frame in rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs validate current link evidence, signer/source, checksum, DIO scope/role, and version, but never require the authenticated L2 destination to be this receiver nor validate the IPv6 destination as allowed local/multicast. These public capability constructors can therefore elevate a valid signed DIO addressed to a different node when used outside the node wrapper, and downstream fragmentation policy trusts the issued capability. Bind issuance to the authority/link receiver's local destination policy (and allowed RPL multicast), or make the unsafe constructor crate-private behind a destination-checked integration API; add cross-destination rejection tests.
